'''Ely Yissachar Merzbach''' ({{langx|he|עלי יששכר מרצבך}}; born 11 February 1950) is an Israeli [[mathematician]] and emeritus professor at [[Bar-Ilan University]]'s Department of Mathematics and the Gonda Brain Research Center.

==Biography==
Ely Merzbach was born in 1950 in Paris, where he attended [[École Yabné (Paris)|École Yabné]]. He [[Aliyah|immigrated to Israel]] at the age of 17, studying for a year at [[Be'er Ya'akov|Yeshivat Be'er Ya'akov]] and then enlisting in the [[Nahal Brigade]] of the [[Israel Defense Forces]]. He obtained a B.Sc. in mathematics and statistics and an M.Sc. in mathematics from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]], and completed his doctoral studies in 1979 at [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev]].

==Academic career==
After working as a [[postdoctoral fellow]] at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Paris 6]] and the [[École Polytechnique]], Merzbach joined the faculty at [[Bar-Ilan University]] in 1980, becoming [[Professor (highest academic rank)|full professor]] in 1993.

His research focuses on [[Point process|point processes theory]], [[measure theory]], [[stochastic geometry]], and applications thereof.<ref>{{cite journal | last=Merzbach | first=Ely | last2=Singer | first2=Boris | title=How to construct a partition when preference sets are given | journal=Computers & Operations Research | volume=21 | issue=10 | year=1994 | issn=0305-0548 | doi=10.1016/0305-0548(94)90036-1 | pages=1061–1068}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://studiahumana.com/author,Ely-Merzbach.html|title=Ely Merzbach|website=Studia Humana|publisher=University of Information Technology and Management|location=[[Rzeszów]]}}</ref>

He served as head of the Bar-Ilan's Department of Mathematics and Computer Science from 1991, academic head of [[Ariel University]] from 1996 to 1997, and was elected dean of the Faculty of Exact Sciences at Bar-Ilan in 1997.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://u.cs.biu.ac.il/~merzbach/|title=Ely Merzbach|access-date=23 February 2019|website=Bar-Ilan University|archive-date=3 December 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101203061924/http://u.cs.biu.ac.il/~merzbach/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since April 2021 he serves as president of Michlalah Jerusalem College.
